rust_summary: a tamed mob's death message to its owner, as a mod may change or silence it (`native_living_death_message`).
doc_summary: `native_living_death_message(entity, kind, message)` is asked for the death message a tamed mob sends its owner (`TamableAnimal.die`), once the message is built and only when it would be sent (owner online, `show_death_messages` on). `message` holds the text: replace it, or set it to `None` to tell the owner nothing. Every mod is asked in order. Server and host. Bundles need "hooks": @API:living_death_message@.
